fields.name: thermal_conductivity
fields.rationale: Thermal conductivity is a key property for insulation materials, indicating how well the material can insulate against heat transfer.

fields.name: compressive_strength
fields.rationale: Compressive strength is important for understanding the load-bearing capacity of insulation materials, especially in construction applications.

fields.name: carbonation_rate
fields.rationale: Carbonation rate affects the durability and environmental impact of cement-based materials, influencing CO2 sequestration.
evidence: carbonation rates were set as follows: 40% in the manufacturing phase, 50% in the use phase
